remediation.fix_approach: Added sessionStorage.removeItem('macroFileList') to StorageService.setNotConnected() so macro file list is cleared on logout, preventing cross-session disclosure and eliminating the sessionStorage injection vector for VULN-007.
remediation.root_cause: setNotConnected() removed gx_token, idPcode, and userName but not macroFileList. In shared-browser scenarios (kiosk, shared workstation), User A's macro names were visible to User B after User A logged out in the same tab. Also provided a sessionStorage injection vector: XSS could inject malicious macro names before logout without cleanup.
remediation.verification_needed: After logout, verify sessionStorage has no 'macroFileList' key. Log in as User A, use macros, log out — log in as User B and confirm macro list is empty.
remediation.defense_in_depth: VULN-007 selected() validation means even if macroFileList contained traversal sequences, they would be rejected at the UI entry point.
remediation.testing: 1. Login, load macros (macroFileList populated), logout. 2. Verify sessionStorage.getItem('macroFileList') returns null after logout.
remediation.residual_risk: Low. Macro names are still stored in sessionStorage during an active session. The fragile comma-split storage format is a code quality issue (not a security fix target for this round).
